companionGroups.description: Every companion group among the manifest's bills, complete on every response (full, windowed, snapshot), sorted by primaryGuid. [] = no groups (or disabled); field absent = server predates companion groups.

updatedAt.description: When something last happened to the bill: the processed bill's storedAt at its first publication or at its latest news (a status change, an action newer than its latest or another on that day, or a new text version). A reprocess, a re-summary of the same text or a change to its details (cosponsors, member votes, committees, older actions, topics, life areas) keeps it (since 2026-10-28).

subCategories.description: The processed bill's sub-category labels, except that a ceremonial resolution (one that designates a day or week, or recognizes, honors or congratulates someone) has none (since 2026-10-29). A bill summarized before Civil Rights and Liberties and Heritage and Identity replaced Social Justice and Identity Politics may still carry the old names, which clients show under the new names.

lifeAreas.description: The processed bill's life areas, except that a ceremonial resolution (one that designates a day or week, or recognizes, honors or congratulates someone) has none.

sponsors.description: Bioguide IDs, copied from the processed bill.

cosponsors.description: Bioguide IDs, copied from the processed bill: every Congress.gov cosponsor since REL-28, only the first 20 on a bill fetched before it (see the processed bill's cosponsors).

voteCount.description: Deprecated: no longer sent (INT-11). A vote count is other users' votes, which nobody sees before voting on the bill; clients must not show or sort by it. Kept optional so older builds keep decoding.

vetoed.description: Only as true, when the processed bill's actions show a veto that stands (billOutcomes.ts deriveBillVetoedFromActions); absent otherwise. billStatus keeps its value. Clients that predate it ignore it.

isCommemorative.description: Only as true, when the bill is a ceremonial resolution (one that designates a day or week, or recognizes, honors or congratulates someone; commemorativeResolutions.ts isCommemorativeResolution, the rule that also leaves its subCategories and lifeAreas empty); absent otherwise. Clients that predate it ignore it.

introducedDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the day the bill was introduced, from the processed bill's introducedDate when it has one, else its earliest dated action (later than the introduction for a bill with more than the newest 250 actions a fetch stores). Absent when neither gives a date.

passedHouseOn.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the earliest action coded 8000, Passed/agreed to in House (billOutcomes.ts chamberPassageDates); absent when no stored action records it (a fetch stores the newest 250 actions). A vote over a veto (32000), on an amendment or on a motion is not one. Set whatever billStatus says: a bill that later failed or became law keeps it. A bill reaches the second chamber only once the chamber it began in passed it, so a bill that began in the Senate and has passedHouseOn passed the Senate too, even when passedSenateOn is absent because that action is older than the stored ones.

passedSenateOn.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the earliest action coded 17000, Passed/agreed to in Senate (billOutcomes.ts chamberPassageDates); absent when no stored action records it (a fetch stores the newest 250 actions). A vote over a veto (34000), on an amendment or on a motion is not one. Set whatever billStatus says. A bill reaches the second chamber only once the chamber it began in passed it, so a bill that began in the House and has passedSenateOn passed the House too, even when passedHouseOn is absent because that action is older than the stored ones.

latestAction.title: BillsManifestLatestActionV1
latestAction.description: The bill's latest action, the one the app's bill page and the website show as Latest action (UX-43; billManifestFacts.ts latestManifestAction): of the processed bill's actions, those of the greatest actionDate, then the first listed (congress.gov lists the newest first; actionTime is not read, as many Library of Congress lines have none). An action without text counts only when no action of its date has text and its type or veto code has a label in the apps. Absent when there is no such action or its date is not a calendar day.

text.description: Congress.gov's text, trimmed, citations included. Absent when that action has none (the apps then show its type).
